descriptionPlain:
OUR STORY:
 
🇪🇺 Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow !
Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies.
 
Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector.
 
With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants.
 
Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen.
 
📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.
 


WHY WE NEED YOU ?
Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Sales team to support the expansion of our enterprise client portfolio in Financial Services sector.
 
Your mission will be to lead strategic account acquisition in France, focusing on large enterprises within Financial Services ecosystem, in order to accelerate revenue growth, boost our presence in key industries, and support our ambition to become the European leader in sovereign cloud solutions.
 
 
YOUR FUTURE TEAM
We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together.
 
 You will be part of a 15-person team of Account Executives, organized by verticals and industry sectors.

 The team is embedded in cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Marketing, and Product departments.
 
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
• Open, manage and grow enterprise accounts in Financial Services vertical.
• Develop and execute account and territory strategies, driving both new business and expansion opportunities.
• Be the first point of contact for enterprise clients, building trusted relationships at all levels of the organization.
• Provide regular reporting to management on account activity, pipeline maturity, strategic Sales & Marketing initiatives and quarterly numbers reviews.
• Capacity to find solutions in order to contractualize complex business agreements.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure customer needs are met and to coordinate Sales delivery (capacity to find alternatives).
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of our products and services.
 
 
ABOUT YOU
 
🧠 Soft Skills
• Exceptional communication and influencing skills
• Strong ability to build relationships with multiple stakeholders, including C-level executives and partners
• Curious, adaptable
 
💼 Hard Skills
• Proven experience and network in Financial Services vertical
• Proven track record in enterprise sales and strategic account development
• Ability to open, manage and grow multiple enterprise accounts
• Understanding of Cloud & AI ecosystem and how they solve business challenges
• Ability to translate technical solutions into business outcomes for executive-level stakeholders
• Experience with digital transformation initiatives, industrial automation, or AI-driven optimization projects
• Experience using sales tools and platforms relevant to enterprise cloud sales (Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)
• Fluent in English and French
 
WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++
• Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.
• Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.
• Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.
• Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.
• International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.
• Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers.
 
 
WHY JOIN THE SCALEWAY ADVENTURE ?
✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.
✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.
✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.
 
🔜 THE NEXT STEPS …
Discovery call with a recruiter (30 min)
Interview with Head of Sales (45 min)
Interview with VP Sales (45 min)
Team and CSO Interview - at the office

OUR STORY:
 
🇪🇺 Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow !
Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies.
 
Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector.

📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.
 
WHY WE NEED YOU?
Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Supply Chain team to support production activities and ensure efficient procurement and stock management processes.
Your mission will be to manage procurement operations and optimize supply chain processes in order to improve delivery performance and ensure component availability across our datacenters.
YOUR FUTURE TEAM
We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together.
You will be part of a team of 2 people. The team is responsible for managing procurement for production and spare parts, as well as leading Supply Chain improvement projects (KPI monitoring, ERP optimization). You will work closely with a Supply Chain Coordinator and interact regularly with cross-functional teams such as Purchasing, Logistics, Production, Hardware, Finance, and Accounting.
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
Manage purchase orders and update delivery dates in the ERP
Follow up with suppliers to confirm and secure delivery timelines
Replenish spare parts stocks in datacenters
Monitor and update monthly KPIs related to supply chain performance
Contribute to stock analysis and optimization
Update ERP Supply Chain master data
Collaborate with internal teams to collect and update master data in our ERP
Participate in improving On-Time Delivery performance
Support the documentation and writing of supply chain procedures

ABOUT YOU
HARDSKILLS
Academic background (Master’s degree level) in Supply Chain, Logistics, or related field
First experience (internship or apprenticeship) in procurement or supply chain, preferably in an industrial or technical environment
Experience working with ERP systems (Odoo is a plus)
Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets for data analysis
Familiarity with KPI monitoring and stock analysis
● Professional written and verbal communication in French and English

📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.
 
WHY WE NEED YOU?
Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Supply Chain team to support production activities and ensure efficient procurement and stock management processes.
Your mission will be to manage procurement operations and optimize supply chain processes in order to improve delivery performance and ensure component availability across our datacenters.
YOUR FUTURE TEAM
We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together.
You will be part of a team of 2 people. The team is responsible for managing procurement for production and spare parts, as well as leading Supply Chain improvement projects (KPI monitoring, ERP optimization). You will work closely with a Supply Chain Coordinator and interact regularly with cross-functional teams such as Purchasing, Logistics, Production, Hardware, Finance, and Accounting.
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
Manage purchase orders and update delivery dates in the ERP
Follow up with suppliers to confirm and secure delivery timelines
Replenish spare parts stocks in datacenters
Monitor and update monthly KPIs related to supply chain performance
Contribute to stock analysis and optimization
Update ERP Supply Chain master data
Collaborate with internal teams to collect and update master data in our ERP
Participate in improving On-Time Delivery performance
Support the documentation and writing of supply chain procedures

ABOUT YOU
HARDSKILLS
Academic background (Master’s degree level) in Supply Chain, Logistics, or related field
First experience (internship or apprenticeship) in procurement or supply chain, preferably in an industrial or technical environment
Experience working with ERP systems (Odoo is a plus)
Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets for data analysis
Familiarity with KPI monitoring and stock analysis
● Professional written and verbal communication in French and English

WHY WE NEED YOU?
Our growth is driving us to strengthen our HDV tribe within the Hardware Operations team to support the development of a major new project and manage our expanding infrastructure.
Your mission will be to develop and maintain a variety of software solutions, from internal scripting to complex SaaS platforms, in order to bridge the gap between software excellence and hardware performance within our sovereign cloud.
 
YOUR FUTURE TEAM
You will join a tight-knit, high-impact squad of 6 people (including an Engineering Manager and a Tech Lead) dedicated to building QCS - the core software engine powering our physical infrastructure. We operate at the rare intersection of robust application software and data center hardware.
The Mix: Our team balances core Python development, complex React frontends, and automated IaC pipelines. You will work alongside peers who understand both code architecture and physical infrastructure constraints.
How We Work: We run on a lightweight Scrum framework, prioritizing engineering excellence, clean design patterns, and high-impact project milestones.
The Scaler Spirit: We thrive in a highly collaborative, international environment. We value open technical debates, continuous knowledge sharing, and giving every engineer the autonomy to shape the product.
 
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
Develop Core Product Features: Write clean, structured application code in Python to power our hardware update, testing, and inventory systems
Own Your Domain (Frontend or DevOps): Depending on your track, you will either architect complex React/TypeScript admin interfaces or manage our Proxmox clusters, secrets, and automated deployments using Terraform and Ansible.
Bridge Low-Level to High-Level: Work on a diverse codebase ranging from hardware-level data collection to web APIs.
Drive a New Infrastructure Initiative: Partner with the team to design and ship the next major milestones of our next-generation architecture.
Keep the Foundation Rock-Solid: Optimize, refactor, and test a significant volume of existing code to guarantee stability during long-running hardware validation tests.
Maintain Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous peer code reviews, champion clean architecture, and engage in lightweight Scrum ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprints, retros).
 
ABOUT YOU
HARDSKILLS:
Your major – Core Software Engineering (Essential): Strong proficiency in Applicative Python: You are a software engineer at heart. You care about clean code, architecture, testing, API design, and building robust backend systems. You have at least 4 years of experience writing structured application code.
Your minor – Choose Your Secondary Strength (At least one):You don’t need to know our entire stack, but you should bring professional experience in at least one of these cross-cutting areas:
The Frontend Track: Experience building highly responsive web applications using React and TypeScript. Proficient in modern state management and data-fetching patterns. Comfortable handling complex asynchronous states, long-polling, or real-time updates.
The DevOps/IaC Track: Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation pipelines. Ansible and Terraform to provision virtualized clusters (Proxmox, …), building robust GitLab CI/CD workflows using Docker containers, and/or deploying/managing core APIs on Kubernetes. Orchestrating service VMs and automating system-level scripts or image builds is highly valued.
Nice to have:
The Systems Track: Solid foundations in Linux Sysadmin, networking protocols (VLANs, routing), bare-metal provisioning (DHCP, PXE, TFTP), or building custom Linux OS images (e.g., debootstrap/casper/mkosi). Bonus points if you've ever interacted with physical hardware labs or configuration management (like NX-OS).
WHAT IF YOU HAVE LIGHT/NO EXPERIENCE IN THE OTHER MINOR TRACKS OR DON’T KNOW THE SYSTEMS SIDE ? Apply anyway. We know this is a highly specialized stack sitting at the intersection of bare-metal hardware and cloud software. We do not expect you to be an expert in everything on day one. What we do require is intense technical curiosity.
 
SOFT SKILLS:
Ability to work autonomously within a structured Scrum environment
Highly involved, conscientious, and proactive in project delivery
Excellent communicator with a collaborative "OneTeam" mindset
Humble and open to constructive feedback
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
Continuous learner, eager to pick up new technologies and bridge technical gaps across our stack

OUR STORY:
 
🇪🇺 Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow !
Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies.
 
Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector.
 
With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants.
 
Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen.
 
📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.
 

WHY WE NEED YOU?

Our growth is driving us to strengthen our HDV tribe within the Hardware Operations team to support the development of a major new project and manage our expanding infrastructure.

Your mission will be to develop and maintain a variety of software solutions, from internal scripting to complex SaaS platforms, in order to bridge the gap between software excellence and hardware performance within our sovereign cloud.

 

YOUR FUTURE TEAM

You will join a tight-knit, high-impact squad of 6 people (including an Engineering Manager and a Tech Lead) dedicated to building QCS - the core software engine powering our physical infrastructure. We operate at the rare intersection of robust application software and data center hardware.

  • The Mix: Our team balances core Python development, complex React frontends, and automated IaC pipelines. You will work alongside peers who understand both code architecture and physical infrastructure constraints.
  • How We Work: We run on a lightweight Scrum framework, prioritizing engineering excellence, clean design patterns, and high-impact project milestones.
  • The Scaler Spirit: We thrive in a highly collaborative, international environment. We value open technical debates, continuous knowledge sharing, and giving every engineer the autonomy to shape the product.

 

YOUR DAILY ROUTINE

  • Develop Core Product Features: Write clean, structured application code in Python to power our hardware update, testing, and inventory systems
  • Own Your Domain (Frontend or DevOps): Depending on your track, you will either architect complex React/TypeScript admin interfaces or manage our Proxmox clusters, secrets, and automated deployments using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Bridge Low-Level to High-Level: Work on a diverse codebase ranging from hardware-level data collection to web APIs.
  • Drive a New Infrastructure Initiative: Partner with the team to design and ship the next major milestones of our next-generation architecture.
  • Keep the Foundation Rock-Solid: Optimize, refactor, and test a significant volume of existing code to guarantee stability during long-running hardware validation tests.
  • Maintain Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous peer code reviews, champion clean architecture, and engage in lightweight Scrum ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprints, retros).

 

ABOUT YOU

HARDSKILLS:

  • Your major – Core Software Engineering (Essential):
     Strong proficiency in Applicative Python: You are a software engineer at heart. You care about clean code, architecture, testing, API design, and building robust backend systems. You have at least 4 years of experience writing structured application code.

  • Your minor – Choose Your Secondary Strength (At least one):
     You don’t need to know our entire stack, but you should bring professional experience in at least one of these cross-cutting areas:

    • The Frontend Track: Experience building highly responsive web applications using React and TypeScript. Proficient in modern state management and data-fetching patterns. Comfortable handling complex asynchronous states, long-polling, or real-time updates.

    • The DevOps/IaC Track: Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation pipelines. Ansible and Terraform to provision virtualized clusters (Proxmox, …), building robust GitLab CI/CD workflows using Docker containers, and/or deploying/managing core APIs on Kubernetes. Orchestrating service VMs and automating system-level scripts or image builds is highly valued.

  • Nice to have:

    • The Systems Track: Solid foundations in Linux Sysadmin, networking protocols (VLANs, routing), bare-metal provisioning (DHCP, PXE, TFTP), or building custom Linux OS images (e.g., debootstrap/casper/mkosi). Bonus points if you've ever interacted with physical hardware labs or configuration management (like NX-OS).

WHAT IF YOU HAVE LIGHT/NO EXPERIENCE IN THE OTHER MINOR TRACKS OR DON’T KNOW THE SYSTEMS SIDE ?
 Apply anyway. We know this is a highly specialized stack sitting at the intersection of bare-metal hardware and cloud software. We do not expect you to be an expert in everything on day one. What we do require is intense technical curiosity.

 

SOFT SKILLS:

  • Ability to work autonomously within a structured Scrum environment
  • Highly involved, conscientious, and proactive in project delivery
  • Excellent communicator with a collaborative "OneTeam" mindset
  • Humble and open to constructive feedback
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
  • Continuous learner, eager to pick up new technologies and bridge technical gaps across our stack

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++

  • Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.
  • Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.
  • Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.
  • Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.
  • International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.
  • Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers

 

🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure?

  • ✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.
  • ✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.
  • ✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.

 

🔜 THE NEXT STEPS …

  • Discovery call with a recruiter (30 min)
  • Interview with the Manager to understand your technical skills and approach to the role (45 min)
  • Technical interview with the Tech Lead to validate your expertise (around 2h on site)
  • Final interview to deepen discussions and assess your fit with the team (45 min)
  • HR interview to tour our offices and meet your future colleagues
 
At Scaleway, we are committed to building an inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone has a fair opportunity to thrive.
All applications are considered with care, regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, or any other characteristic.
We believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone which is why you should definitely apply.

Instances that won’t start
Network & Connectivity : Unreachable services, Blocked ports, Incorrect firewall/security group configurations
IP or DNS issues, Failed inter-server communication
Storage : Inaccessible volumes, Snapshot failures, Degraded disk performance, Attachment errors
Insufficient storage space
Cloud Platform & Access : Authentication issues (SSH, access), Insufficient permissions, API errors
Quota limits reached, Resources failing to deploy properly
 
- Identify recurring issues and contribute to the continuous improvement of internal procedures and solutions.
- Work closely with internal teams to escalate complex technical issues or share client feedback.

SOFTSKILLS :
- Proficiency in French and English: Customer-service oriented, mastery of polite phrases in both languages, ability to assist clients in resolving their issues using professional language.

- Willingness to learn and share knowledge: Curiosity and eagerness to work in a team, and to learn from your own experiences and those of others.

- Comfortable using ticketing tools and handling multiple requests simultaneously.
- Use of operating systems, Linux systems, and virtualization systems.
- Network administration and IP address management.
- Analyzing, understanding, and diagnosing complex technical issues.

descriptionBody:
WHY WE NEED YOU ?
 
Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Customer Support team.
Your mission will be to understand the fundamentals of cloud infrastructure (systems, networking, virtualization) and help customers resolve technical issues.
 
YOUR FUTURE TEAM : 
 
Within a team of around 10 people, and supported by your team leader, you will act as the link between customers, support, engineering, and product teams, while contributing to the continuous improvement of support processes and practices.
 
Your role will be to serve as the technical point of contact for our customers (tickets and phone) on topics related to cloud infrastructure and products. Your mission: analyze, diagnose, and guide customers in resolving their incidents.
 
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE :
 
- Provide high-quality customer support by responding to requests via a ticketing system or by phone.
- Diagnose customer incidents and guide them toward resolution, including:
Compute / Systems : Inaccessible VMs, CPU/RAM performance issues, failing Linux services, Full disks
Instances that won’t start
Network & Connectivity : Unreachable services, Blocked ports, Incorrect firewall/security group configurations
IP or DNS issues, Failed inter-server communication
Storage : Inaccessible volumes, Snapshot failures, Degraded disk performance, Attachment errors
Insufficient storage space
Cloud Platform & Access : Authentication issues (SSH, access), Insufficient permissions, API errors
Quota limits reached, Resources failing to deploy properly
 
- Identify recurring issues and contribute to the continuous improvement of internal procedures and solutions.
- Work closely with internal teams to escalate complex technical issues or share client feedback.
 
ABOUT YOU: 
 
SOFTSKILLS :
- Proficiency in French and English: Customer-service oriented, mastery of polite phrases in both languages, ability to assist clients in resolving their issues using professional language.
- Technological interest and logical thinking: Basic knowledge of hardware or software, good logic in handling and solving technical problems.
- Willingness to learn and share knowledge: Curiosity and eagerness to work in a team, and to learn from your own experiences and those of others.
 
💻 HARDSKILLS : 
- Comfortable using ticketing tools and handling multiple requests simultaneously.
- Use of operating systems, Linux systems, and virtualization systems.
- Network administration and IP address management.
- Analyzing, understanding, and diagnosing complex technical issues.
 
WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++
 
Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.
Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.
Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.
Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.
International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French. 
Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers.
 
🚀Why join the Scaleway adventure ? 
 
✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.
✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.
✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.
 
🔜 THE NEXT STEPS…
Discovery call with a recruiter (30 min)
Interview with the manager to understand your technical skills and approach to the role (60 min)
HR interview to tour our offices and meet your future colleagues

Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector.
 
With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants.
 
Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen.
 
📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.
 


WHY WE NEED YOU?
Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Marketplace team to build a brand-new product from the ground up, managing the creation and distribution of core artifacts like OS images and container images.
Your mission will be to lead and develop the software components and architecture for our Marketplace platform in order to deliver a scalable, diverse, and high-performance product offering to all Scaleway users.
YOUR FUTURE TEAM
We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together.
You will be part of a team of initially 1 person (yourself), with the objective to recruit and grow the team to approximately 5 to 10 engineers. As this is a new initiative, you will work closely with Product Management (Marie Debard) and Engineering leadership to define the technical vision.
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
Tasks
Design and develop the Marketplace platform architecture from scratch
Implement backend services primarily using Go and SQL
Create and manage the lifecycle of artifacts, including OS and container images
Develop and maintain robust APIs to power Marketplace features
Architect distributed systems focused on high scalability and microservices
Collaborate cross-functionally with Core Engineering and Product teams
Participate in the definition of technical specifications and product roadmaps
Ensure code quality through rigorous testing and documentation
Recruit, mentor, and lead the future members of the Marketplace engineering team
Balance hands-on development with strategic engineering management
 
 
ABOUT YOU
HARDSKILLS:
Strong proficiency in Go and experience with Python
Solid experience in SQL and database management
Expertise in Linux system administration and internals
Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
Proven track record in building APIs and Distributed Architectures
Deep understanding of Microservices and Scalability
Proficiency with Git and CI/CD workflows
Experience in creating and managing artifacts (OS images, containers)
SOFT SKILLS:
High level of autonomy and ownership
Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset
Adaptability to a fast-evolving, "start-up" style project environment
Excellent leadership and communication skills
Pragmatic and results-oriented approach
 
WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++
Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.
Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.
Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.
Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.
International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.
Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers.

🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure?
✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.
✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.
✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.
 
🔜 THE NEXT STEPS …
Discovery call with a recruiter (30 min)
Interview with the manager, to understand your technical skills and approach to the role (45 min)
Technical deep dive (Use Case) to validate your expertise with team experts
Interview with the Head of Tribe/Product to deepen discussions and assess your fit with the team (45 min)
HR interview to tour our offices and meet your future colleagues

WHY WE NEED YOU ? 
As our GPU Cloud infrastructure continues to scale, we are strengthening our SRE organization to support the deployment and operation of increasingly large and complex AI infrastructure.
Your mission will be to lead our Site Reliability Engineering team and ensure the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our GPU clusters.
You will combine engineering leadership and technical ownership, helping the team automate critical infrastructure workflows, improve observability, and operate production-grade GPU platforms powering our sovereign cloud.
 
YOUR FUTURE TEAM 
We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a strong culture of knowledge sharing, helps us bring ambitious projects to life.
You will lead a team of 6 Site Reliability Engineers within the GPU Cloud organization.
The team works on some of our most critical AI and HPC infrastructure challenges, including GPU cluster automation, server lifecycle management, observability, reliability, and the integration of new GPU technologies.
You will collaborate closely with other GPU Cloud engineering teams, Product, Operations, and stakeholders across Scaleway.
 
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE 
Tasks
Lead and manage a team of 6 Site Reliability Engineers, supporting both their technical execution and career development
Provide technical leadership on the architecture, reliability, and operation of large-scale GPU infrastructure
Design and drive automation for server provisioning and lifecycle management across GPU clusters
Build and improve observability, monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities for production infrastructure
Own the SRE team's technical roadmap, priorities, and delivery
Ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and resilience of production GPU clusters
Drive continuous improvements in automation, incident management, and operational processes
Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Operations, and other GPU Cloud teams
Recruit, onboard, coach, and develop engineers within the team
Lead incident response and post-incident improvements when critical production issues occur

ABOUT YOU 
HARDSKILLS:
Strong experience managing engineering teams in high-constraint production environments
Proven expertise with Kubernetes container orchestration
Experience with monitoring, metrics, and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana)
Familiarity to modern GPU hardware ecosystems (Nvidia, AMD) and high-speed networking fabric (InfiniBand, Spectrum-X, Tomahawk)
Knowledge of distributed and high-performance storage solutions (Lustre DDN, VAST)
SOFT SKILLS:
Strong engineering leadership and team management capabilities
Technical rigor and high attention to detail in production-critical environments
Ability to handle high-pressure operational situations and manage incident stress pragmatically
Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey challenging messages effectively
Collaborative mindset with a focus on empowering engineers rather than micromanaging

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++ 
Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.
Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.
Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.
Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.
International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.
Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers.

🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure?
✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.
✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.
✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.

🔜 THE NEXT STEPS …
Discovery call with HR
Technical interview with the HPC team to understand your technical skills and approach to the role
Manager interview to validate your expertise
Interview with an Engineering Manager / Head of Engineering to deepen discussions and assess your fit with the team 
HR interview and office visit to tour our offices and meet your future colleagues

descriptionBody:
WHY WE NEED YOU ? 

As our GPU Cloud infrastructure continues to scale, we are strengthening our SRE organization to support the deployment and operation of increasingly large and complex AI infrastructure.

Your mission will be to lead our Site Reliability Engineering team and ensure the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our GPU clusters.

You will combine engineering leadership and technical ownership, helping the team automate critical infrastructure workflows, improve observability, and operate production-grade GPU platforms powering our sovereign cloud.

 

YOUR FUTURE TEAM 

We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a strong culture of knowledge sharing, helps us bring ambitious projects to life.

You will lead a team of 6 Site Reliability Engineers within the GPU Cloud organization.

The team works on some of our most critical AI and HPC infrastructure challenges, including GPU cluster automation, server lifecycle management, observability, reliability, and the integration of new GPU technologies.

You will collaborate closely with other GPU Cloud engineering teams, Product, Operations, and stakeholders across Scaleway.

 

YOUR DAILY ROUTINE 

Tasks

  • Lead and manage a team of 6 Site Reliability Engineers, supporting both their technical execution and career development
  • Provide technical leadership on the architecture, reliability, and operation of large-scale GPU infrastructure
  • Design and drive automation for server provisioning and lifecycle management across GPU clusters
  • Build and improve observability, monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities for production infrastructure
  • Own the SRE team's technical roadmap, priorities, and delivery
  • Ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and resilience of production GPU clusters
  • Drive continuous improvements in automation, incident management, and operational processes
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Operations, and other GPU Cloud teams
  • Recruit, onboard, coach, and develop engineers within the team
  • Lead incident response and post-incident improvements when critical production issues occur


ABOUT YOU 

HARDSKILLS:

  • Strong experience managing engineering teams in high-constraint production environments

  • Proven expertise with Kubernetes container orchestration

  • Experience with monitoring, metrics, and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana)

  • Familiarity to modern GPU hardware ecosystems (Nvidia, AMD) and high-speed networking fabric (InfiniBand, Spectrum-X, Tomahawk)

  • Knowledge of distributed and high-performance storage solutions (Lustre DDN, VAST)

SOFT SKILLS:

  • Strong engineering leadership and team management capabilities

  • Technical rigor and high attention to detail in production-critical environments

  • Ability to handle high-pressure operational situations and manage incident stress pragmatically

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey challenging messages effectively

  • Collaborative mindset with a focus on empowering engineers rather than micromanaging


WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++ 

  • Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.

  • Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.

  • Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.

  • Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.

  • International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.

  • Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers.

🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure?

✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.

✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.

✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.

🔜 THE NEXT STEPS …

  • Discovery call with HR
  • Technical interview with the HPC team to understand your technical skills and approach to the role
  • Manager interview to validate your expertise
  • Interview with an Engineering Manager / Head of Engineering to deepen discussions and assess your fit with the team 
  • HR interview and office visit to tour our offices and meet your future colleagues

Tasks

● Prepare the logistics of events (orders, deliveries, goodies, materials, and assets)

● Ensure on-site event operations, including setup, coordination, and real-time issue resolution

● Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure smooth execution

● Support the installation and dismantling of event booths and spaces

● Follow operational checklists to guarantee high-quality execution

● Assist in managing multiple events simultaneously

● Anticipate needs and proactively solve operational issues

● Comfortable working with tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Suite, Slack, or similar

● Professional written and verbal communication in French and English

● HR screening call (20 min)

● Interview with Leila Munch, Field Marketing Manager, to assess your experience and motivation (45 min)

● Preparation and presentation of a case study with Leila Munch and Paola Gabriele

● (Optional) Final team fit discussion to meet the team and deepen exchanges

YOUR FUTURE TEAM
You will join a tight-knit, high-impact squad of 6 people (including an Engineering Manager and a Tech Lead) dedicated to building QCS - the core software engine powering our physical infrastructure. We operate at the rare intersection of robust application software and data center hardware.
The Mix: Our team balances core Python development, complex React frontends, and automated IaC pipelines. You will work alongside peers who understand both code architecture and physical infrastructure constraints.
How We Work: We run on a lightweight Scrum framework, prioritizing engineering excellence, clean design patterns, and high-impact project milestones.
The Scaler Spirit: We thrive in a highly collaborative, international environment. We value open technical debates, continuous knowledge sharing, and giving every engineer the autonomy to shape the product.
 
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
Develop Core Product Features: Write clean, structured application code in Python to power our hardware update, testing, and inventory systems
Own Your Domain (Frontend or DevOps): Depending on your track, you will either architect complex React/TypeScript admin interfaces or manage our Proxmox clusters, secrets, and automated deployments using Terraform and Ansible.
Bridge Low-Level to High-Level: Work on a diverse codebase ranging from hardware-level data collection to web APIs.
Drive a New Infrastructure Initiative: Partner with the team to design and ship the next major milestones of our next-generation architecture.
Keep the Foundation Rock-Solid: Optimize, refactor, and test a significant volume of existing code to guarantee stability during long-running hardware validation tests.
Maintain Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous peer code reviews, champion clean architecture, and engage in lightweight Scrum ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprints, retros).

HARDSKILLS:
Your major – Core Software Engineering (Essential): Strong proficiency in Applicative Python: You are a software engineer at heart. You care about clean code, architecture, testing, API design, and building robust backend systems. You have at least 4 years of experience writing structured application code.
Your minor – Choose Your Secondary Strength (At least one):You don’t need to know our entire stack, but you should bring professional experience in at least one of these cross-cutting areas:
The Frontend Track: Experience building highly responsive web applications using React and TypeScript. Proficient in modern state management and data-fetching patterns. Comfortable handling complex asynchronous states, long-polling, or real-time updates.
The DevOps/IaC Track: Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation pipelines. Ansible and Terraform to provision virtualized clusters (Proxmox, …), building robust GitLab CI/CD workflows using Docker containers, and/or deploying/managing core APIs on Kubernetes. Orchestrating service VMs and automating system-level scripts or image builds is highly valued.
Nice to have:
The Systems Track: Solid foundations in Linux Sysadmin, networking protocols (VLANs, routing), bare-metal provisioning (DHCP, PXE, TFTP), or building custom Linux OS images (e.g., debootstrap/casper/mkosi). Bonus points if you've ever interacted with physical hardware labs or configuration management (like NX-OS).

Ability to work autonomously within a structured Scrum environment

With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants.
 
Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen.
 
📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.
 

WHY WE NEED YOU?

Our growth is driving us to strengthen our HDV tribe within the Hardware Operations team to support the development of a major new project and manage our expanding infrastructure.

Your mission will be to develop and maintain a variety of software solutions, from internal scripting to complex SaaS platforms, in order to bridge the gap between software excellence and hardware performance within our sovereign cloud.

 

YOUR FUTURE TEAM

You will join a tight-knit, high-impact squad of 6 people (including an Engineering Manager and a Tech Lead) dedicated to building QCS - the core software engine powering our physical infrastructure. We operate at the rare intersection of robust application software and data center hardware.

  • The Mix: Our team balances core Python development, complex React frontends, and automated IaC pipelines. You will work alongside peers who understand both code architecture and physical infrastructure constraints.
  • How We Work: We run on a lightweight Scrum framework, prioritizing engineering excellence, clean design patterns, and high-impact project milestones.
  • The Scaler Spirit: We thrive in a highly collaborative, international environment. We value open technical debates, continuous knowledge sharing, and giving every engineer the autonomy to shape the product.

 

YOUR DAILY ROUTINE

  • Develop Core Product Features: Write clean, structured application code in Python to power our hardware update, testing, and inventory systems
  • Own Your Domain (Frontend or DevOps): Depending on your track, you will either architect complex React/TypeScript admin interfaces or manage our Proxmox clusters, secrets, and automated deployments using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Bridge Low-Level to High-Level: Work on a diverse codebase ranging from hardware-level data collection to web APIs.
  • Drive a New Infrastructure Initiative: Partner with the team to design and ship the next major milestones of our next-generation architecture.
  • Keep the Foundation Rock-Solid: Optimize, refactor, and test a significant volume of existing code to guarantee stability during long-running hardware validation tests.
  • Maintain Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous peer code reviews, champion clean architecture, and engage in lightweight Scrum ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprints, retros).

 

ABOUT YOU

HARDSKILLS:

  • Your major – Core Software Engineering (Essential):
     Strong proficiency in Applicative Python: You are a software engineer at heart. You care about clean code, architecture, testing, API design, and building robust backend systems. You have at least 4 years of experience writing structured application code.

  • Your minor – Choose Your Secondary Strength (At least one):
     You don’t need to know our entire stack, but you should bring professional experience in at least one of these cross-cutting areas:

    • The Frontend Track: Experience building highly responsive web applications using React and TypeScript. Proficient in modern state management and data-fetching patterns. Comfortable handling complex asynchronous states, long-polling, or real-time updates.

    • The DevOps/IaC Track: Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation pipelines. Ansible and Terraform to provision virtualized clusters (Proxmox, …), building robust GitLab CI/CD workflows using Docker containers, and/or deploying/managing core APIs on Kubernetes. Orchestrating service VMs and automating system-level scripts or image builds is highly valued.

  • Nice to have:

    • The Systems Track: Solid foundations in Linux Sysadmin, networking protocols (VLANs, routing), bare-metal provisioning (DHCP, PXE, TFTP), or building custom Linux OS images (e.g., debootstrap/casper/mkosi). Bonus points if you've ever interacted with physical hardware labs or configuration management (like NX-OS).

WHAT IF YOU HAVE LIGHT/NO EXPERIENCE IN THE OTHER MINOR TRACKS OR DON’T KNOW THE SYSTEMS SIDE ?
 Apply anyway. We know this is a highly specialized stack sitting at the intersection of bare-metal hardware and cloud software. We do not expect you to be an expert in everything on day one. What we do require is intense technical curiosity.

 

SOFT SKILLS:

  • Ability to work autonomously within a structured Scrum environment
  • Highly involved, conscientious, and proactive in project delivery
  • Excellent communicator with a collaborative "OneTeam" mindset
  • Humble and open to constructive feedback
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
  • Continuous learner, eager to pick up new technologies and bridge technical gaps across our stack

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++

  • Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.
  • Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.
  • Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.
  • Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.
  • International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.
  • Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers

 

🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure?

  • ✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.
  • ✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.
  • ✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.

 

🔜 THE NEXT STEPS …

  • Discovery call with a recruiter (30 min)
  • Interview with the Manager to understand your technical skills and approach to the role (45 min)
  • Technical interview with the Tech Lead to validate your expertise (around 2h on site)
  • Final interview to deepen discussions and assess your fit with the team (45 min)
  • HR interview to tour our offices and meet your future colleagues
 
At Scaleway, we are committed to building an inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone has a fair opportunity to thrive.
All applications are considered with care, regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, or any other characteristic.
We believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone which is why you should definitely apply.

We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together.

- Gather and analyze functional requirements from Product teams (Compute, AI, Storage).
- Identify optimal hardware solutions from global vendors (ODM, OEM).
- Evaluate technical specifications and drive their evolution to meet Scaleway’s standards.
- Collaborate on the customization of existing or new hardware solutions.
- Conduct cost analysis and TCO evaluations to validate project financial viability.
- Support Product teams in building business plans with hardware expertise.
- Follow the full development lifecycle of hardware solutions from design to implementation.
- Maintain a constant technology watch on market components and hardware trends.
- Synthesize and document technical choices and project progress.
- Interact daily with external vendors and internal engineering experts.
 
 
 
ABOUT YOU
 
HARDSKILLS:
- 5 to 10+ years of experience in Hardware Architecture or Engineering.
- Expertise in server technologies (Compute, Storage, HPC, AI).
- Deep knowledge of the hardware vendor ecosystem (ODM, OEM) and components.
- Proficiency in communication protocols and Datacenter infrastructure.
- Ability to conduct financial evaluations and TCO analysis.
 
SOFT SKILLS:
- Excellent communication skills with both technical and business profiles.
- Strong ability to synthesize information and maintain rigorous documentation.
- High level of technical curiosity combined with a business-driven mindset.
- Hands-on approach with the ability to work in a laboratory environment (DC5).
- Strong alignment with strategic objectives and OKRs.

Discovery call with a recruiter (30 min)
Interview with Stephane Dutilleul (Manager) to discuss your skills and vision (45 min)
Team Interview including a technical deep dive and a live session with the manager (1h)
Final visit to our offices and laboratory (DC5) to meet your future colleagues.

descriptionBody:
WHY WE NEED YOU ?
 
Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Hardware Architecture team to source and design our future hardware solutions.
 
Your mission will be to translate functional requirements from our Product teams into concrete hardware solutions (Storage, Compute, AI, HPC) in order to ensure the technical performance and financial relevance of our sovereign cloud infrastructure.
 
 
YOUR FUTURE TEAM
 
We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together.
 
You will join a team of experts working on Open Hardware (OCP) projects and engaging in co-design with global hardware vendors. You will be at the heart of our infrastructure strategy, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Validation teams.
Manager information: Stephane Dutilleul
 
 
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
- Gather and analyze functional requirements from Product teams (Compute, AI, Storage).
- Identify optimal hardware solutions from global vendors (ODM, OEM).
- Evaluate technical specifications and drive their evolution to meet Scaleway’s standards.
- Collaborate on the customization of existing or new hardware solutions.
- Conduct cost analysis and TCO evaluations to validate project financial viability.
- Support Product teams in building business plans with hardware expertise.
- Follow the full development lifecycle of hardware solutions from design to implementation.
- Maintain a constant technology watch on market components and hardware trends.
- Synthesize and document technical choices and project progress.
- Interact daily with external vendors and internal engineering experts.
 
 
 
ABOUT YOU
 
HARDSKILLS:
- 5 to 10+ years of experience in Hardware Architecture or Engineering.
- Expertise in server technologies (Compute, Storage, HPC, AI).
- Deep knowledge of the hardware vendor ecosystem (ODM, OEM) and components.
- Proficiency in communication protocols and Datacenter infrastructure.
- Ability to conduct financial evaluations and TCO analysis.
 
SOFT SKILLS:
- Excellent communication skills with both technical and business profiles.
- Strong ability to synthesize information and maintain rigorous documentation.
- High level of technical curiosity combined with a business-driven mindset.
- Hands-on approach with the ability to work in a laboratory environment (DC5).
- Strong alignment with strategic objectives and OKRs.
 
WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++
 
Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.
Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.
Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.
Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.
International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.
Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers
 
🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure?
✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.
✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.
✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.
 
🔜 THE NEXT STEPS …
Discovery call with a recruiter (30 min)
Interview with Stephane Dutilleul (Manager) to discuss your skills and vision (45 min)
Team Interview including a technical deep dive and a live session with the manager (1h)
Final visit to our offices and laboratory (DC5) to meet your future colleagues.

Familiarity in GPU and/or HPC environments, ideally involving NVIDIA and AMD technologies

WHY WE NEED YOU ?
As our GPU Cloud business continues to scale, we are strengthening our operational capabilities to support the deployment and operation of increasingly large and complex GPU clusters.
Your mission will be to lead the operational delivery of new GPU clusters, coordinate our strategic suppliers and partners, and build the processes and operating model required to run our infrastructure reliably at scale.
You will play a key role in increasing our operational autonomy, ensuring that new clusters move efficiently from deployment to production while continuously improving how we operate and maintain our GPU infrastructure.

YOUR FUTURE TEAM
We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a strong culture of knowledge sharing, helps us bring ambitious projects to life.
You will initially operate as a highly autonomous individual contributor within the GPU Cloud organization.
The role is highly cross-functional and sits at the intersection of Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, Hardware, Supply Chain, Service Management, and GTM.
You will work closely with approximately 15 GPU Cloud engineers, as well as internal teams and external technology partners, to coordinate the deployment and operation of large-scale AI and HPC infrastructure.

YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
Tasks
Direct the project management of GPU clusters
Manage and drive suppliers during both project and run phases
Oversee day-to-day run tracking with the support of dedicated contributors
Organize interfaces and coordination with other Scaleway departments (hardware, supply chain, data centers)
Line manage and support a Technical Account Manager (TAM)
Design and implement the required organization to target autonomy in GPU cluster operations and maintenance
Handle crisis management situations with manufacturers when SLAs or service commitments are impacted
Collaborate with key infrastructure and GPU partners (Nvidia, AMD, Dell, HPE, VAST, DDN, Juniper)

ABOUT YOU
HARDSKILLS:

descriptionPlain:
OUR STORY:
 
🇪🇺 Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow !
Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies.
 
Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector.
 
With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants.
 
Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen.
 
📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.
 


WHY WE NEED YOU
Scaleway is experiencing hyper-growth, and our business in Italy is expanding rapidly! To support this strong momentum and scale our presence in the Italian market, we are strengthening our Business Development team in our Milan office.
Your mission will be to proactively identify, contact, and qualify prospects across Italy to generate a high-quality sales pipeline. Working hand-in-hand with our local Account Executive based in Milan, you will actively participate in outbound prospecting and represent Scaleway at key industry events to boost our sovereign cloud adoption.
YOUR FUTURE TEAM
We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of "Scalers," combined with a spirit of sharing, brings new projects to life every single day. You will join our Italian team based directly in Milan, working in tandem with the broader international BDR organization.
You will work closely with our local Account Executive—co-owning field events and targeted outbound campaigns—as well as Marketing and Sales Ops to handle a growing volume of leads and accelerate our market penetration in Italy.
YOUR DAY-TO-DAY
Your responsibilities:
Conduct targeted outbound prospecting to identify key decision-makers across the Italian market.
Maintain a high level of daily sales activity, combining structured call campaigns and tailored multi-channel cadences.
Leverage LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, and data enrichment tools to optimize outreach and target ideal points of contact.
Manage a steady flow of incoming leads generated by our expanding presence and brand awareness in Italy.
Partner closely with the local Account Executive to prepare for, attend, and follow up on key industry events and field marketing actions.
Rigorously manage lead data and pipeline stages in Salesforce/HubSpot.
Conduct discovery calls to uncover true client pain points rather than relying on a rigid checklist.
Qualify leads using the MEDDIC framework to ensure high-quality opportunities for the local region.
Challenge prospects' assumptions with courtesy and professional assertiveness.
Participate in strategy sessions to refine cadences and market penetration strategies for Italy.
ABOUT YOU
TECHNICAL SKILLS (Hard Skills):
Native or fluent in Italian (essential for building strong relationships in the local market) and fluent in English (our main working language across hubs).
1 to 3 years of experience in an outbound-focused sales role (BDR/SDR/Inside Sales).
Demonstrated success in hitting activity quotas and a strong mastery of cold prospecting fundamentals.
Proficiency in MEDDIC or a similar sales qualification methodology.
Experience with modern sales stack tools (Salesforce/HubSpot, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
Strong ability to use open-ended questions to identify core business challenges.
REQUIRED QUALITIES (Soft Skills):
Resilience: Ability to handle constant rejection while maintaining positive energy and drive.
Curiosity: A natural "hunter" mindset with a strong desire to understand how tech and cloud ecosystems work.
Coachability: Openness to feedback and the capacity to quickly adapt sales techniques.
Assertiveness: Comfortable taking charge of conversations and challenging prospects.
Active Listening: Ability to engage in authentic, consultative conversations rather than sticking strictly to a script.
WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++
Paris HQ Onboarding: A comprehensive 1-week onboarding program at our Paris headquarters to kickstart your journey. Travel (flights/trains) and hotel accommodation are fully covered by Scaleway (meals on your own).
Location & Offices: Based in our vibrant Milan offices, fully equipped to offer a collaborative and modern workspace.
Hybrid Work: Up to 3 days of remote work per week.
Catering & Benefits: Dedicated regional perks (e.g., meal vouchers/Swile card where applicable) and access to company wellness initiatives.
Well-being Commitment: Scaleway is dedicated to your work-life balance through comprehensive support programs.
International Environment: Representing dozens of nationalities across our offices in Paris, Lille, and Milan.
Career & Mobility: Our managers actively encourage internal mobility; career opportunities within the iliad Group are accessible to everyone.
🚀 Why join the adventure?
✔ A product catalog of over 100 public cloud services (IaaS, PaaS, AI).
✔ A cutting-edge technical environment (high-performance Bare Metal).
✔ A commitment to a sustainable cloud (Data centers powered by renewable energy since 2017).
🔜 NEXT STEPS...
HR interview with the Talent Acquisition team (30 min).
Interview with the Hiring Manager focused on your experience and strategy for the Italian market (45 min).
Role-play / Practical case study (including video responses) to validate your expertise (1 hr).
Interview with the Head of BDR and the local Italian Account Executive (team fit) (45 min).
Final exchange with the CSO.

With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants.
 
Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen.
 
📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.
 

WHY WE NEED YOU ?

Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Solutions Architect team to increase customer acquisition and support, and promote our market expansion. Your mission will be to act as the primary technical contact for our clients and prospects during the first phases of their project in order to design future-proof architectures, resolve real migration challenges, and enable customer success on our public cloud platform.

 

YOUR FUTURE TEAM

We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together. You will be part of the global Pre-Sales Architecture team. You will be paired with Account Executives to focus on market expansion, industrialization, and strategic partnerships.

 

YOUR DAILY ROUTINE

  • Engage deeply with technical contacts and C-level executives to build Scaleway Architectures

  • Conduct deep customer project analysis after initial sales qualification

  • Guide clients through their migration process until the support team takes over

  • Identify customer and prospect pain points throughout the Sales discovery process

  • Recommend matching Scaleway products, solutions, and services to help customers generate business value

  • Develop positive, long-term relationships with customers to understand their evolving technical requirements

  • Collaborate with the commercial team to accelerate sales cycles and drive technical validation

 
ABOUT YOU

HARDSKILLS:

  • Experience as a Technical Sales Engineer or Pre-Sales Solutions Architect in a Cloud environment

  • Strong expertise in Cloud development, migrations, container orchestration, or applications/servers

  • Proficiency in one or more of the following: Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Linux system administration, application development, or Datacenter components

  • Professional working proficiency in English (any additional language is a plus)

  • Degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

 

SOFT SKILLS:

  • Hybrid expertise acting as both a Sales & Tech Expert

  • Strong relationship-building skills to establish trust with B2B customers and C-level stakeholders

  • Customer-centric mindset with a focus on enabling client success

  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset to address complex migration challenges

  • Collaborative spirit, comfortable partnering closely with Account Executives and Business Developers

 

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++

  • Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.

  • Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.

  • Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.

  • Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.

  • International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.

  • Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers.

 

🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure?

✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.

✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.

✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.
 

🔜 THE NEXT STEPS …

1 - Talent acquisition interview (30 min)
2 - Head of Sales Architecture / International PSA (30 min)
3 - Technical Interview to understand your technical skills and approach to the role (1h)
4 - CSO Interview (30 min)

 Your mission will be to guide clients through their cloud journey with Scaleway, from discovery to migration, in order to accelerate customer acquisition and deliver tailor-made technical solutions.

We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together.
 
 You will be part of a team of experienced Pre-Sales Architects, paired with Account Executives, Inside Sales Representatives, Customer Success Managers, and Business Developers, all working together to serve strategic markets.
 
You’ll operate closely with the Sweden-based sales team while remaining integrated within the global Solutions Architecture department.
 
YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
 
- Act as the primary technical contact during the pre-sales phase for enterprise prospects and clients
- Understand customer business needs and technical constraints to design Scaleway-based architectures
- Support clients throughout the discovery and migration journey until the project transitions to support
- Conduct in-depth technical discovery and propose custom solutions leveraging Scaleway products
- Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to address customer challenges
- Drive technical workshops and proof-of-concept sessions with clients
- Maintain and share knowledge on Scaleway’s evolving cloud offering
- Participate in improving internal pre-sales tools and processes
- Represent Scaleway at industry events and webinars when needed
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Pre-Sales practice and documentation
 
ABOUT YOU
 
HARDSKILLS
- 3 to 10 years of experience in technical pre-sales or solution architecture roles
- Experience working with public cloud solutions and migrations
- Familiarity with container orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, or Linux systems
- Solid understanding of application/server architectures and datacenter environments
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English
 
SOFTSKILLS
- Customer-oriented with a consultative mindset
- Ability to understand and translate complex technical requirements into scalable solutions
- Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management abilities
- Comfortable presenting to both technical and C-level audiences
- Proactive, adaptable, and eager to drive innovation
